fields.label: Rule Code
fields.description: Must exactly match a discount rule whose Calculation Type is Tiered.

fields.label: Sales From (Inclusive)
fields.description: Lower boundary in company base currency; bands must not overlap.

fields.label: Sales To (Exclusive)
fields.description: Upper boundary in base currency. Leave zero for no upper limit (last band).

fields.label: Tier Discount %
fields.description: Whole Band: percentage for entire eligible sales amount; Progressive: percentage on this sales band's portion.

fields.label: Tier Fixed Bonus (Base)
fields.description: Additional fixed amount when this tier is reached. For Progressive mode only the final reached tier's bonus is applied.
